subtitle.en: Naming your feelings and calming down
subtitle.hg: Feelings ko naam dena aur shaant hona

hook.en: Happy, sad, angry, scared. Everyone has feelings, even grown-ups.
hook.hg: Khush, udaas, gussa, darr. Feelings sabke andar hoti hain, bade logon ke bhi.

objectives.hg: Paanch alag-alag feelings ke naam bata sako.

objectives.en: Use slow breathing to calm down.
objectives.hg: Dheemi saans lekar khud ko shaant kar sako.

objectives.en: Tell a trusted grown-up when a feeling is too big.
objectives.hg: Jab koi feeling bahut badi lage, toh bharose wale bade ko bata sako.

body.en: Feelings are what you feel inside. Happy, sad, angry, scared, shy and excited are all feelings. Everyone has them. Children have them. Grown-ups have them too. When you say the name of a feeling, like 'I am sad', it gets a little easier to handle.
body.hg: Feeling woh hai jo tum apne andar mehsoos karte ho. Khushi, udaasi, gussa, darr, sharmana aur excitement, yeh sab feelings hain. Yeh sabke andar hoti hain. Bachchon ke andar bhi, bade logon ke andar bhi. Jab tum feeling ka naam bolte ho, jaise 'main udaas hoon', toh usse sambhalna thoda aasaan ho jaata hai.

body.en: Feelings show up in your body. When you are angry, your face may feel hot. When you are scared, your heart may beat fast. When you are worried, your tummy may hurt. These signs are your body saying, 'Something is going on. Please notice me.'
body.hg: Feelings body mein bhi dikhti hain. Gussa aane par chehra garam lag sakta hai. Darr lagne par dil tez dhadak sakta hai. Chinta hone par pet mein dard ho sakta hai. Yeh ishaare hain. Tumhari body keh rahi hai, 'Kuch ho raha hai. Meri taraf dhyaan do.'

body.en: No feeling is bad. It is okay to cry. It is okay to feel angry. Boys can cry. Girls can feel angry. But hitting someone, saying mean words or breaking things is not okay. You can feel angry and still keep your hands and your words kind.
body.hg: Koi bhi feeling buri nahi hoti. Rona theek hai. Gussa aana bhi theek hai. Ladke ro sakte hain. Ladkiyon ko gussa aa sakta hai. Lekin kisi ko maarna, buri baatein kehna ya cheezein todna theek nahi hai. Gussa aaye, tab bhi tum apne haath aur apni baatein pyaar bhari rakh sakte ho.

body.en: When a feeling gets too big, stop. Put a hand on your tummy. Breathe in slowly, then breathe out slowly, five times. Drink some water. Then tell a grown-up you trust, like Mummy, Papa, Dadi or your teacher. Telling is brave. Grown-ups can help you.
body.hg: Jab koi feeling bahut badi ho jaaye, toh ruk jao. Pet par haath rakho. Dheere-dheere saans andar lo, phir dheere-dheere bahar chhodo, paanch baar. Thoda paani piyo. Phir kisi bharose wale bade ko batao, jaise Mummy, Papa, Dadi ya teacher. Batana bahaduri hai. Bade tumhari help kar sakte hain.

claim.hg: Achche bachchon ko kabhi gussa nahi aata.

fact.en: Every child feels angry sometimes. Feeling angry is okay. Hurting someone is not okay.
fact.hg: Har bachche ko kabhi-kabhi gussa aata hai. Gussa aana theek hai. Kisi ko chot pahunchana theek nahi hai.

takeaways.en: All feelings are okay, and they all have names.
takeaways.hg: Saari feelings theek hain, aur sabke naam hote hain.

takeaways.en: Slow breaths make a big feeling smaller.
takeaways.hg: Dheemi saansein badi feeling ko chhoti kar deti hain.

takeaways.en: Tell a trusted grown-up when a feeling is too big.
takeaways.hg: Jab feeling bahut badi lage, toh bharose wale bade ko batao.

activity.en: Draw four faces: happy, sad, angry and scared. Show them to a grown-up at home and tell them when you last felt each one.
activity.hg: Chaar chehre banao: khush, udaas, gusse wala aur dara hua. Ghar ke kisi bade ko dikhao aur batao ki tumhe har feeling pichhli baar kab hui thi.

q.en: Riya is very angry because her brother took her toy. What is a good thing to do?
q.hg: Riya ko bahut gussa aa raha hai kyunki bhai ne uska khilona le liya. Kya karna achha rahega?

options.en: Hit her brother
options.hg: Bhai ko maar de

options.en: Take slow breaths and tell a grown-up
options.hg: Dheemi saansein le aur kisi bade ko bataye

options.en: Break the toy
options.hg: Khilona tod de

explain.en: Feeling angry is okay. Slow breaths calm the body, and a grown-up can help fix the problem.
explain.hg: Gussa aana theek hai. Dheemi saansein body ko shaant karti hain, aur koi bada problem solve karne mein help kar sakta hai.

q.en: It is okay for a boy to cry when he feels sad.
q.hg: Udaas hone par ladke ka rona theek hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Crying is how the body lets sadness out. It is okay for everyone, boys and girls.
explain.hg: Rokar body udaasi ko bahar nikaalti hai. Yeh sabke liye theek hai, ladkon ke liye bhi aur ladkiyon ke liye bhi.

title.en: Growing Up Without the Comparison Trap
title.hg: Comparison Trap Se Bachke Bade Hona

subtitle.en: Puberty worries, body image and self-esteem
subtitle.hg: Puberty ki tension, body image aur self-esteem

hook.en: Someone in class is taller. Someone has clearer skin. Someone already looks grown up. Your brain keeps score, and the scoreboard is rigged.
hook.hg: Class mein koi zyada lamba hai. Kisi ki skin zyada clear hai. Koi abhi se bada dikhne laga hai. Tumhara dimaag score ginta rehta hai, aur yeh scoreboard hi rigged hai.

objectives.en: Explain why bodies in the same class change at different times.
objectives.hg: Samjha sako ki ek hi class ke bachchon ki bodies alag-alag time par kyun badalti hain.

objectives.en: Spot how filters and advertisements distort what looks normal.
objectives.hg: Pehchaan sako ki filters aur ads 'normal' ki picture ko kaise bigaadte hain.

objectives.en: Name what builds self-esteem and whom to ask for help.
objectives.hg: Bata sako ki self-esteem kin cheezon se banta hai aur help kisse maangni hai.

body.en: Puberty usually begins between 8 and 13 in girls and between 9 and 14 in boys, so in one classroom some bodies have changed a lot and some have not started. Both are normal. Almost everyone worries about something: being too short, too tall, too hairy, not hairy enough, breasts, voice, pimples, sweat. The worry feels private, but most classmates carry their own version of it. Starting early or late does not decide how you will finally look. If nothing has started by 13 for girls or 14 for boys, a doctor can check, and usually everything is fine.
body.hg: Puberty aam taur par ladkiyon mein 8 se 13 saal aur ladkon mein 9 se 14 saal ke beech shuru hoti hai. Isliye ek hi class mein kuch bachchon ki body kaafi badal chuki hoti hai aur kuch ki shuru bhi nahi hui hoti. Dono normal hain. Lagbhag har kisi ko koi na koi tension rehti hai: height kam hai, height bahut zyada hai, baal zyada hain, baal kam hain, breasts, awaaz, pimples, paseena. Yeh tension sirf apni lagti hai, par class ke zyadatar bachche apna-apna version lekar ghoom rahe hote hain. Jaldi ya late shuru hona yeh decide nahi karta ki tum finally kaise dikhoge. Agar ladkiyon mein 13 aur ladkon mein 14 saal tak kuch bhi shuru na ho, toh doctor check kar sakte hain, aur zyadatar sab theek hi nikalta hai.

body.en: Your brain compares automatically; it is how humans work out where they stand. The trouble is that the comparison is unfair. You see your own body in the bathroom mirror on a bad day, and other people at their best angle. Online it is worse: filters smooth skin, change face shape and lighten skin tone, and people post one photo out of fifty. Advertisements for fairness creams, height powders and weight-loss products earn money by making you feel something is wrong with you. When the 'I look worse' thought arrives, name it: 'That is the comparison trap.'
body.hg: Dimaag apne aap compare karta hai; insaan isi tarah samajhta hai ki woh kahan khada hai. Problem yeh hai ki yeh comparison fair nahi hota. Tum apni body bure din par bathroom ke mirror mein dekhte ho, aur doosron ko unke best angle se. Online haal aur bura hai: filters skin smooth kar dete hain, face ka shape badal dete hain aur rang gora kar dete hain, aur log pachaas mein se ek photo hi daalte hain. Fairness cream, height powder aur weight-loss products ke ads isi se kamaate hain ki tumhe lage tum mein koi kami hai. Jab 'baaki sab mujhse achhe dikhte hain' wala thought aaye, toh usse naam do: 'Yeh comparison trap hai.'

h.en: What self-esteem is really made of
h.hg: Self-esteem actually kis cheez se banta hai

body.en: Self-esteem means feeling that you are worth something even on a bad day. It does not come from looking a certain way. It grows from things you do: learning a skill, keeping a promise, helping someone, finishing something hard. Rules like 'boys do not cry' or 'girls must be thin and fair' are stereotypes, not facts, and they leave everyone feeling they are failing. Teasing someone about weight, height, skin colour, body hair or a changing voice is bullying, even when it is called a joke. You can refuse to join in, and you can say 'that is not funny'.
body.hg: Self-esteem ka matlab hai yeh feel karna ki bure din par bhi tumhari value hai. Yeh kisi khaas tarah dikhne se nahi aata. Yeh un kaamon se badhta hai jo tum karte ho: koi skill seekhna, promise nibhana, kisi ki help karna, koi mushkil kaam poora karna. 'Ladke rote nahi' ya 'ladkiyon ko patla aur gora hona chahiye' jaisi baatein stereotypes hain, facts nahi, aur inki wajah se har kisi ko lagta hai ki woh fail ho raha hai. Kisi ke weight, height, rang, body hair ya badalti awaaz ka mazaak udana bullying hai, chahe usse 'joke' hi kyun na bola jaaye. Tum usme shaamil hone se mana kar sakte ho, aur bol sakte ho 'yeh funny nahi hai.'

body.en: Stress shows up in the body: headaches, stomach aches, trouble sleeping, snapping at people, not wanting to go to school. The things that help are simple and real: enough sleep, moving your body, time away from the screen, doing something you enjoy, and saying the worry aloud to someone you trust. If worry about your body or anything else stays for many days, or teasing does not stop, tell a parent, teacher or school counsellor. You can also call Tele-MANAS on 14416, a free mental health helpline, or the Child Helpline on 1098. Asking for help is a skill, not a weakness.
body.hg: Stress body mein dikhta hai: sirdard, pet dard, neend na aana, chhoti baat par chidh jaana, school jaane ka mann na karna. Jo cheezein help karti hain woh simple aur real hain: poori neend, body ko move karna, screen se door thoda time, koi pasand ka kaam, aur apni tension kisi bharose wale insaan ko bolkar batana. Agar apni body ya kisi aur baat ki tension kai dinon tak bani rahe, ya chidhana band na ho, toh parents, teacher ya school counsellor ko batao. Tum Tele-MANAS 14416 par bhi call kar sakte ho, yeh free mental health helpline hai, ya Child Helpline 1098 par. Help maangna ek skill hai, kamzori nahi.

claim.en: If my puberty started late or early, my body will never turn out normal.
claim.hg: Agar meri puberty late ya jaldi shuru hui, toh meri body kabhi normal nahi banegi.

fact.en: Timing varies widely and does not decide the final result. Bodies that start early and bodies that start late both grow into normal adult bodies.
fact.hg: Timing sabki alag hoti hai aur isse final result decide nahi hota. Jaldi shuru hone wali aur late shuru hone wali, dono bodies normal adult bodies banti hain.

takeaways.en: Puberty has a wide normal timetable, so comparing bodies in class means comparing different stages.
takeaways.hg: Puberty ka normal timetable bahut wide hai, isliye class mein bodies compare karna actually alag-alag stages compare karna hai.

takeaways.en: Photos online are chosen, edited and filtered, so they are not a fair mirror.
takeaways.hg: Online photos chuni hui, edited aur filtered hoti hain, isliye woh fair mirror nahi hain.

takeaways.en: Self-esteem grows from what you do and how you treat people, and help is there when worry feels heavy.
takeaways.hg: Self-esteem isse badhta hai ki tum kya karte ho aur logon se kaise pesh aate ho, aur jab tension heavy lage toh help available hai.

activity.en: Write down three things your body lets you do (run, draw, dance, hug, cycle) and one thing you are getting better at. Keep the list where you can see it on a bad day.
activity.hg: Teen aisi cheezein likho jo tumhari body tumhe karne deti hai (daudna, drawing, dance, hug karna, cycle chalana) aur ek cheez jisme tum better ho rahe ho. Yeh list aisi jagah rakho jahan bure din par dikh jaaye.

q.en: Two classmates are both 12. One has started puberty and the other has not. What does this mean?
q.hg: Do classmates 12 saal ke hain. Ek ki puberty shuru ho chuki hai aur doosre ki nahi. Iska kya matlab hai?

options.en: The one who has not started has a health problem
options.hg: Jiski shuru nahi hui, usse koi health problem hai

options.en: The one who started early will stay ahead forever
options.hg: Jiski jaldi shuru hui, woh hamesha aage rahega

options.en: Both are within the normal range
options.hg: Dono normal range mein hain

options.en: Both should see a doctor urgently
options.hg: Dono ko turant doctor ke paas jaana chahiye

explain.en: Puberty can begin anywhere in a range of several years, so both classmates are developing normally.
explain.hg: Puberty kai saalon ki range mein kabhi bhi shuru ho sakti hai, isliye dono classmates ka development normal hai.

q.en: A filtered photo on social media is a reliable way to judge how someone really looks.
q.hg: Social media par filter lagi photo se reliably pata chalta hai ki koi actually kaisa dikhta hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Filters change skin, face shape and colour, and people post only their best pictures, so the photo is not real life.
explain.hg: Filters skin, face shape aur rang badal dete hain, aur log sirf apni best photos daalte hain, isliye woh photo real life nahi hai.

title.en: Pressure, Rejection and Shame: A Survival Guide
title.hg: Pressure, Rejection aur Sharam: Survival Guide

subtitle.en: What to do with the feelings nobody talks about
subtitle.hg: Un feelings ka kya karein jinki koi baat nahi karta

hook.en: Left on seen. Left out of the plan. Laughed at for not having 'done anything' yet. These hurt for real, and there are better moves than pretending you are fine.
hook.hg: Seen karke chhod diya. Plan se bahar rakha. 'Abhi tak kuch kiya nahi' bolkar hansi udayi. Yeh sab sach mein chubhta hai, aur 'main theek hoon' ka natak karne se better moves available hain.

objectives.en: Tell the difference between guilt and shame.
objectives.hg: Guilt aur shame ka fark bata sako.

objectives.en: Respond to pressure to date or be sexually active.
objectives.hg: Date karne ya sexually active hone ke pressure ka jawab de sako.

objectives.en: Choose coping that helps over coping that harms.
objectives.hg: Nuksaan karne wali coping ki jagah help karne wali coping chun sako.

h.en: Why rejection and loneliness hurt so much
h.hg: Rejection aur akelapan itna kyun dukhta hai

body.en: Being rejected by a crush, dropped by a friend group or left out of a plan can hurt like a physical injury, and between 13 and 15 the brain is especially tuned to what peers think. That is why one unanswered message can ruin a whole day. Rejection tells you about the fit between two people at one moment; it is not a score of your worth. Loneliness is also common, even among people who look popular online. It is a signal, like hunger, that you need connection, and it eases with small real contact: one honest conversation, one shared activity, one person.
body.hg: Crush ka mana kar dena, friend group se nikaal diya jaana ya kisi plan se bahar rakha jaana physical chot jaisa dard de sakta hai, aur 13 se 15 ki age mein dimaag is baat par khaas dhyaan deta hai ki peers kya sochte hain. Isiliye ek message ka reply na aana poora din kharab kar sakta hai. Rejection bas yeh batata hai ki us moment mein do logon ka fit nahi baitha; yeh tumhari worth ka score nahi hai. Akelapan bhi bahut common hai, un logon mein bhi jo online bahut popular dikhte hain. Yeh bhookh ki tarah ek signal hai ki tumhe connection chahiye, aur yeh chhote-chhote real contact se halka hota hai: ek honest baatcheet, saath mein kiya ek kaam, ek insaan.

body.en: Guilt says 'I did something wrong'. Shame says 'I am something wrong'. Guilt can be useful: it pushes you to apologise or repair. Shame mostly makes people hide. Many teenagers carry shame about things that are simply normal: sexual thoughts, masturbation, body changes, attraction, including to the same gender, or not feeling attraction at all. None of these makes you dirty or bad. Shame grows in silence and shrinks when you get accurate information or tell one safe person. If the shame comes from something another person did to you or pushed you into, the wrong is theirs, never yours; tell a trusted adult or call Child Helpline 1098.
body.hg: Guilt kehta hai 'maine kuch galat kiya.' Shame kehti hai 'main hi galat hoon.' Guilt useful ho sakta hai: woh tumhe sorry bolne ya galti theek karne ki taraf push karta hai. Shame zyadatar insaan ko chhupne par majboor karti hai. Bahut se teenagers aisi cheezon ki shame dhote hain jo bilkul normal hain: sexual thoughts, masturbation, body changes, attraction, jisme same gender ki taraf attraction bhi shaamil hai, ya attraction feel hi na hona. Inme se koi bhi cheez tumhe ganda ya bura nahi banati. Shame chuppi mein badhti hai aur sahi information milne ya kisi ek safe insaan ko batane se ghatti hai. Agar shame kisi aisi cheez se aa rahi hai jo kisi aur ne tumhare saath ki ya tumse pressure daalkar karwayi, toh galti uski hai, tumhari kabhi nahi; kisi trusted adult ko batao ya Child Helpline 1098 par call karo.

h.en: Pressure to date or be sexual
h.hg: Date karne ya sexual hone ka pressure

body.en: Friends, films and reels can make it seem that everyone your age is in a relationship or sexually active. Most of that is exaggeration; loud stories travel further than true ones. Not being interested, not being ready, or deciding to wait is a complete and respectable choice, and nobody is owed an explanation. Anyone who teases, dares or says 'if you loved me you would' is using pressure, and pressure is the opposite of consent. In India, the POCSO Act treats any sexual act with a person under 18 as an offence even if they agreed. Respect other people's 'no' and 'not yet' as firmly as your own.
body.hg: Friends, films aur reels se aisa lag sakta hai ki tumhari age ka har koi relationship mein hai ya sexually active hai. Isme zyadatar exaggeration hota hai; shor wali stories sachchi stories se zyada door tak pahunchti hain. Interest na hona, ready na hona ya wait karne ka decision lena ek complete aur respectable choice hai, aur iski safai tumhe kisi ko nahi deni. Jo chidhata hai, dare deta hai ya kehta hai 'pyaar karte toh maan jaate', woh pressure daal raha hai, aur pressure consent ka opposite hai. India mein POCSO Act ke under 18 saal se kam umar ke person ke saath koi bhi sexual act offence hai, chahe usne haan hi kyun na boli ho. Doosron ki 'no' aur 'abhi nahi' ki utni hi respect karo jitni apni.

h.en: Coping that helps, coping that harms
h.hg: Coping jo help kare, coping jo harm kare

body.en: Coping is whatever you do to get through a hard feeling. Helpful coping lowers the feeling without creating a new problem: sleep, sport or a walk, music, writing it down, slow breathing, talking to a friend or an adult, taking a break from an app. Harmful coping gives quick relief and a bigger bill later: scrolling all night, skipping meals, alcohol, smoking or vaping, picking fights, hurting yourself. If low mood, worry or anger stays on most days for two weeks or more, or you think about harming yourself, tell a trusted adult and call Tele-MANAS on 14416. If you are in immediate danger, call 112.
body.hg: Mushkil feeling se nikalne ke liye tum jo bhi karte ho, woh coping hai. Helpful coping feeling ko halka karti hai aur koi nayi problem khadi nahi karti: neend, sport ya walk, music, likh daalna, dheemi saansein, kisi friend ya adult se baat karna, kisi app se kuch din ka break. Harmful coping turant relief deti hai aur baad mein bada bill thamati hai: raat bhar scroll karna, khana skip karna, alcohol, smoking ya vaping, jhagde mol lena, khud ko hurt karna. Agar low mood, tension ya gussa do hafte ya usse zyada time tak lagbhag har din bana rahe, ya khud ko nuksaan pahunchane ke thoughts aayein, toh kisi trusted adult ko batao aur Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo. Agar turant khatra ho, toh 112 par call karo.

claim.en: Strong people handle their problems alone.
claim.hg: Strong log apni problems akele handle karte hain.

fact.en: Asking for help is a coping skill, not a failure. Talking to someone you trust makes hard feelings easier to carry and problems easier to solve; hiding them usually makes them heavier.
fact.hg: Help maangna ek coping skill hai, failure nahi. Kisi bharose wale se baat karne par mushkil feelings halki lagti hain aur problems solve karna aasaan hota hai; chhupane se woh aksar aur heavy ho jaati hain.

takeaways.en: Rejection is about fit at one moment, not a verdict on your worth.
takeaways.hg: Rejection us moment ke fit ki baat hai, tumhari worth par koi verdict nahi.

takeaways.en: Guilt is about an action you can repair; shame about normal thoughts and bodies is not deserved.
takeaways.hg: Guilt kisi aise action ka hota hai jo repair ho sakta hai; normal thoughts aur body ko lekar shame tum deserve nahi karte.

takeaways.en: Waiting is a valid choice, and Tele-MANAS 14416 or a trusted adult is there when feelings do not lift.
takeaways.hg: Wait karna ek valid choice hai, aur jab feelings halki na hon toh Tele-MANAS 14416 ya koi trusted adult available hai.

activity.en: Make a private 'bad day plan': three things that calm you, two people you could message, and one helpline number (14416). Save it in your notes.
activity.hg: Apna ek private 'bad day plan' banao: teen cheezein jo tumhe calm karti hain, do log jinhe tum message kar sakte ho, aur ek helpline number (14416). Isse apne notes mein save kar lo.

q.en: Which of these thoughts is shame rather than guilt?
q.hg: Inme se kaun-sa thought guilt nahi, shame hai?

options.en: 'I should not have shouted at my sister.'
options.hg: 'Mujhe behen par chillana nahi chahiye tha.'

options.en: 'I am a disgusting person.'
options.hg: 'Main ek ghatiya insaan hoon.'

options.en: 'I need to say sorry for lying.'
options.hg: 'Mujhe jhooth bolne ke liye sorry bolna hai.'

options.en: 'I broke my promise and should fix it.'
options.hg: 'Maine promise toda aur mujhe isse theek karna chahiye.'

explain.en: Shame attacks who you are; guilt is about a specific action that you can apologise for or repair.
explain.hg: Shame is par attack karti hai ki tum kaun ho; guilt kisi specific action ke baare mein hota hai jiske liye sorry bol sakte ho ya jisse repair kar sakte ho.

q.en: Kabir's friends call him 'still a kid' because he has never had a girlfriend. What is the most accurate thing for Kabir to remember?
q.hg: Kabir ke friends usse 'abhi bachcha hai' bolte hain kyunki uski kabhi girlfriend nahi rahi. Kabir ke liye sabse sahi baat kya yaad rakhna hai?

options.en: Something is wrong with his development
options.hg: Uske development mein kuch gadbad hai

options.en: He should find a girlfriend quickly to fit in
options.hg: Group mein fit hone ke liye usse jaldi girlfriend bana leni chahiye

options.en: Not being interested or choosing to wait is a normal, valid choice
options.hg: Interest na hona ya wait karna choose karna normal aur valid choice hai

explain.en: There is no deadline for relationships. Teasing is pressure, and peers often exaggerate their own experience.
explain.hg: Relationship ki koi deadline nahi hoti. Chidhana pressure hai, aur peers aksar apna experience badha-chadhakar batate hain.

warning.en: If you are thinking about harming yourself, you deserve help right now: tell a trusted adult, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, or call 112 in an emergency.
warning.hg: Agar khud ko nuksaan pahunchane ke thoughts aa rahe hain, toh tumhe abhi help milni chahiye: kisi trusted adult ko batao, Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo, ya emergency mein 112 par call karo.

title.en: Anxious, Heartbroken or Being Controlled? Know the Difference
title.hg: Anxiety, Heartbreak ya Control? Fark Pehchano

subtitle.en: Relationship anxiety, breakups and emotional abuse
subtitle.hg: Relationship anxiety, breakup aur emotional abuse

hook.en: Checking if they are online. Rereading one message twenty times. Feeling scared to say no. Some of this is ordinary anxiety. Some of it is a warning.
hook.hg: Baar-baar check karna ki woh online hai ya nahi. Ek hi message bees baar padhna. 'No' bolne mein darr lagna. Isme se kuch normal anxiety hai. Kuch warning hai.

objectives.en: Describe relationship anxiety and ways to steady it.
objectives.hg: Relationship anxiety ko pehchaan sako aur usse steady karne ke tareeke bata sako.

objectives.en: Get through a breakup without harming yourself or the other person.
objectives.hg: Khud ko ya saamne wale ko harm kiye bina breakup se guzar sako.

objectives.en: Recognise the pattern of emotional abuse and know where to get help.
objectives.hg: Emotional abuse ka pattern pehchaan sako aur jaan sako ki help kahan milegi.

body.en: Relationship anxiety is the constant worry that the other person will leave, lose interest or is hiding something. It shows up as checking their last-seen, needing instant replies, testing them, or agreeing to things just to avoid a fight. Some worry is normal when you care about someone. It becomes a problem when it runs your day or pushes you to cross your own boundaries. What steadies it: saying the worry plainly instead of testing, keeping your own friends, sleep and studies, and asking whether the anxiety comes from your thoughts or from how you are actually being treated. A relationship that keeps you permanently on edge deserves a harder look.
body.hg: Relationship anxiety ka matlab hai lagataar yeh darr ki saamne wala chhod dega, uska interest khatam ho jaayega ya woh kuch chhupa raha hai. Yeh aise dikhti hai: baar-baar last-seen check karna, turant reply ki zaroorat feel hona, saamne wale ko test karna, ya jhagde se bachne ke liye har baat maan lena. Jab kisi ki parwah hoti hai toh thodi tension normal hai. Problem tab hai jab yahi tension tumhara poora din chalane lage ya tumse apni hi boundaries tudwane lage. Isse kya steady karta hai: test karne ki jagah apni tension seedhe shabdon mein bolna, apne friends, neend aur padhai banaye rakhna, aur khud se poochhna ki yeh anxiety mere thoughts se aa rahi hai ya is baat se ki mere saath actually kaisa behave ho raha hai. Jo relationship tumhe har waqt edge par rakhe, usse dhyaan se dekhne ki zaroorat hai.

body.en: A breakup can bring crying, anger, poor sleep, no appetite, trouble concentrating and a strong urge to check the other person's profile. This is grief, a normal reaction to losing something that mattered. It usually comes in waves and gets lighter over weeks, not in a straight line. What helps: telling one or two people the truth, keeping your routine, moving your body, muting or unfollowing for a while, and not making big decisions at 2 a.m. What makes it worse: begging, threats and revenge posts. Sharing someone's private photos without consent is also a crime. Accepting the other person's decision to end it is part of respecting consent.
body.hg: Breakup ke baad rona, gussa, neend kharab hona, bhookh na lagna, focus na hona aur saamne wale ki profile baar-baar check karne ki strong urge ho sakti hai. Yeh grief hai, yaani kisi aisi cheez ko khone ka normal reaction jo tumhare liye matter karti thi. Yeh aam taur par waves mein aata hai aur hafton mein halka hota hai, seedhi line mein nahi. Kya help karta hai: ek-do logon ko sach batana, apna routine banaye rakhna, body ko move karna, kuch time ke liye mute ya unfollow karna, aur raat ke 2 baje bade decisions na lena. Kya haal bigaadta hai: gidgidana, dhamkiyan aur revenge posts. Kisi ki private photos uski consent ke bina share karna crime bhi hai. Saamne wale ke relationship khatam karne ke decision ko accept karna consent ki respect karne ka hi hissa hai.

body.en: Emotional abuse is a repeated pattern of behaviour used to control, frighten or shrink another person, without necessarily touching them. Signs include constant insults or 'jokes' about your body or intelligence, demanding passwords and live location, deciding what you wear or whom you meet, cutting you off from friends and family, silent treatment as punishment, threatening to leave, to leak photos or to hurt themselves if you do not obey, and gaslighting, which means denying things that happened until you doubt your own memory. One bad argument is not abuse. A pattern that leaves you scared, guilty and smaller is. It can happen to any gender, and it is never caused by the person on the receiving end.
body.hg: Emotional abuse baar-baar repeat hone wala aisa behaviour hai jisse kisi ko control kiya jaata hai, daraya jaata hai ya chhota feel karaya jaata hai, bhale hi usse touch na kiya jaaye. Iske signs hain: tumhari body ya intelligence ko lekar lagataar insult ya 'jokes', passwords aur live location ki demand, yeh decide karna ki tum kya pehnoge ya kisse miloge, tumhe friends aur family se kaat dena, punishment ke taur par silent treatment, baat na maanne par chhod dene, photos leak karne ya khud ko hurt karne ki dhamki, aur gaslighting, yaani jo hua usse itna mukarna ki tumhe apni hi memory par shak hone lage. Ek bura jhagda abuse nahi hai. Aisa pattern jo tumhe dara hua, guilty aur chhota feel karaye, woh abuse hai. Yeh kisi bhi gender ke saath ho sakta hai, aur iski wajah kabhi bhi woh insaan nahi hota jo isse jhel raha hai.

h.en: Getting out of the fog, and helping a friend
h.hg: Fog se bahar nikalna, aur friend ki help karna

body.en: If this pattern sounds familiar, tell someone outside the relationship: a parent, older sibling, teacher or counsellor, or call Tele-MANAS on 14416. Girls and women can also call 181, and anyone under 18 can call 1098. If a partner threatens self-harm, take it seriously by informing an adult or calling 112, but do not let it hold you in the relationship; you cannot be someone's only safety plan. To support a friend: listen without 'I told you so', say 'this is not your fault', avoid ordering them to leave, stay in touch, and involve a trusted adult if they are in danger or talk about harming themselves.
body.hg: Agar yeh pattern jaana-pehchana lage, toh relationship ke bahar ke kisi insaan ko batao: parent, bade bhai-behen, teacher ya counsellor, ya Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo. Ladkiyan aur women 181 par bhi call kar sakti hain, aur 18 se kam umar ka koi bhi 1098 par call kar sakta hai. Agar partner self-harm ki dhamki de, toh usse seriously lo aur kisi adult ko batao ya 112 par call karo, lekin is dhamki ki wajah se relationship mein bandhe mat raho; tum kisi ka akela safety plan nahi ban sakte. Friend ko support karne ke liye: 'maine pehle hi bola tha' bole bina suno, bolo 'isme tumhari galti nahi hai', usse chhod dene ka order mat do, touch mein raho, aur agar woh danger mein ho ya khud ko hurt karne ki baat kare toh kisi trusted adult ko involve karo.

claim.en: If there is no hitting, it is not abuse.
claim.hg: Agar maar-peet nahi hai, toh woh abuse nahi hai.

fact.en: Abuse is about control, not only bruises. Constant humiliation, threats, isolation and monitoring are emotional abuse, and they can harm a person's mental health deeply.
fact.hg: Abuse ka matlab control hai, sirf chot ke nishaan nahi. Lagataar humiliation, dhamkiyan, sabse alag kar dena aur monitoring emotional abuse hai, aur isse insaan ki mental health ko gehra nuksaan ho sakta hai.

takeaways.en: Some relationship worry is normal; worry that makes you cross your own boundaries needs attention.
takeaways.hg: Relationship mein thodi tension normal hai; jo tension tumse apni hi boundaries tudwaye, us par dhyaan dena zaroori hai.

takeaways.en: Breakup pain is grief that eases in waves, and the other person's decision to leave has to be respected.
takeaways.hg: Breakup ka dard grief hai jo waves mein halka hota hai, aur saamne wale ke jaane ke decision ki respect karni hoti hai.

takeaways.en: A repeated pattern of control, insults, isolation or threats is emotional abuse, and it is never the target's fault.
takeaways.hg: Control, insult, isolation ya dhamkiyon ka baar-baar repeat hone wala pattern emotional abuse hai, aur yeh kabhi jhelne wale ki galti nahi hoti.

activity.en: Privately list five things you need to feel safe and respected with a friend or partner (for example: I can say no, I can see my friends). Use it as your own checklist; you do not have to show anyone.
activity.hg: Privately paanch aisi cheezein likho jo kisi friend ya partner ke saath safe aur respected feel karne ke liye tumhe chahiye (jaise: main no bol sakoon, main apne friends se mil sakoon). Isse apni checklist ki tarah use karo; kisi ko dikhana zaroori nahi.

q.en: Tanvi's boyfriend says, 'If you go on the school trip without me, I will hurt myself.' What is this?
q.hg: Tanvi ka boyfriend kehta hai, 'Agar tum mere bina school trip par gayi, toh main khud ko kuch kar loonga.' Yeh kya hai?

options.en: A sign of how deeply he loves her
options.hg: Is baat ka proof ki woh usse kitna pyaar karta hai

options.en: Something Tanvi must keep secret to protect him
options.hg: Aisi baat jo Tanvi ko usse protect karne ke liye secret rakhni chahiye

options.en: A normal reaction that Tanvi caused
options.hg: Ek normal reaction jiski wajah Tanvi hai

options.en: A threat used to control her; she should tell a trusted adult
options.hg: Usse control karne ke liye di gayi dhamki; usse kisi trusted adult ko batana chahiye

explain.en: Threatening self-harm to stop someone's choices is emotional control. The threat still needs an adult's attention, but Tanvi is not responsible for it.
explain.hg: Kisi ki choices rokne ke liye self-harm ki dhamki dena emotional control hai. Dhamki par kisi adult ka dhyaan jaana phir bhi zaroori hai, par iski zimmedar Tanvi nahi hai.

q.en: Posting an ex's private photos after a breakup can be a legal offence.
q.hg: Breakup ke baad ex ki private photos post karna legal offence ho sakta hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Sharing someone's private images without their consent is an offence under Indian law, whatever the reason for the breakup.
explain.hg: Kisi ki private images uski consent ke bina share karna Indian law mein offence hai, breakup ki wajah chahe jo bhi ho.

warning.en: If you or someone you know is thinking about self-harm or suicide, do not handle it alone: tell a trusted adult now, call Tele-MANAS on 14416, or call 112 if there is immediate danger.
warning.hg: Agar tum ya tumhara koi jaanne wala self-harm ya suicide ke baare mein soch raha hai, toh isse akele handle mat karo: abhi kisi trusted adult ko batao, Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo, ya turant khatra ho toh 112 par call karo.

title.en: Adulting Is Heavy: Stress, Sex Pressure and Real Help
title.hg: Adulting Heavy Hai: Stress, Sex Pressure aur Asli Help

subtitle.en: Loneliness, timelines, shame and how professional support works
subtitle.hg: Akelapan, timelines, shame aur professional support kaise kaam karta hai

hook.en: Job, rent, shaadi questions, a body you are told to fix and a sex life everyone assumes you have. Nobody hands you a manual. This is the closest thing.
hook.hg: Job, rent, shaadi ke sawaal, ek body jisse 'fix' karne ko bola jaata hai aur ek sex life jo sab assume kar lete hain ki tumhari hai hi. Koi manual nahi deta. Yeh uske sabse close cheez hai.

objectives.en: Identify common adult stressors and the basics that protect mental health.
objectives.hg: Adult life ke common stressors aur mental health ko protect karne wale basics pehchaan sako.

objectives.en: Respect your own and others' decisions about being or not being sexually active.
objectives.hg: Sexually active hone ya na hone ke apne aur doosron ke decisions ki respect kar sako.

objectives.en: Explain who the different mental health professionals are and how to reach them.
objectives.hg: Samjha sako ki alag-alag mental health professionals kaun hain aur un tak kaise pahunchein.

body.en: After 18 the pressures change shape. There is exam and job stress, money, moving to a new city where you know nobody, and a family timeline: settle down, marry by a certain age, have a child soon after. Loneliness is common in hostels, PGs and first jobs, and scrolling through other people's engagements and promotions makes it louder. Chronic stress shows in the body as poor sleep, headaches, acidity, irritability and loss of interest. The basics genuinely matter: regular sleep, food, movement, sunlight, and at least one person you speak to honestly each week. Alcohol, nicotine and endless scrolling numb stress for an hour and deepen it over months.
body.hg: 18 ke baad pressures ki shape badal jaati hai. Exam aur job ka stress, paisa, aise naye sheher mein jaana jahan tum kisi ko nahi jaante, aur family ki timeline: settle ho jao, falaan age tak shaadi kar lo, uske turant baad bachcha. Hostel, PG aur pehli job mein akelapan common hai, aur doosron ki engagements aur promotions scroll karte rehne se woh aur loud ho jaata hai. Chronic stress body mein dikhta hai: kharab neend, sirdard, acidity, chidchidapan aur kisi cheez mein mann na lagna. Basics sach mein matter karte hain: regular neend, khana, movement, dhoop, aur kam se kam ek insaan jisse tum har hafte honestly baat karo. Alcohol, nicotine aur endless scrolling stress ko ek ghante ke liye numb karte hain aur mahinon mein usse aur gehra kar dete hain.

h.en: Sex, pressure and the right not to

body.en: Adults face pressure in both directions: to be sexually experienced by a certain age, and to be 'pure' until marriage. Both treat your body as a public scoreboard. Being sexually active, waiting, stopping for a while or never wanting sex are all legitimate adult choices. Some people feel little or no sexual attraction, which is called asexuality and is not a disorder. A partner's desire does not create a duty, in dating or in marriage; consent is needed every time. If you say no and get sulking, insults, threats or 'everyone else does it', that is coercion. Respect works both ways: never mock or pressure someone for their choice or their inexperience.
body.hg: Adults par pressure dono taraf se aata hai: ek taraf yeh ki falaan age tak sexually experienced ho jao, aur doosri taraf yeh ki shaadi tak 'pure' raho. Dono tumhari body ko public scoreboard bana dete hain. Sexually active hona, wait karna, kuch time ke liye ruk jaana ya sex kabhi na chahna, yeh sab legitimate adult choices hain. Kuch logon ko sexual attraction bahut kam ya bilkul feel nahi hoti; isse asexuality kehte hain aur yeh koi disorder nahi hai. Partner ki desire se tum par koi duty nahi ban jaati, na dating mein, na shaadi mein; consent har baar zaroori hai. Agar 'no' bolne par roothna, insult, dhamki ya 'baaki sab toh karte hain' sunne ko mile, toh yeh coercion hai. Respect dono taraf chalti hai: kisi ki choice ya inexperience par na uska mazaak udao, na us par pressure daalo.

h.en: Shame, guilt and body image in adult life
h.hg: Adult life mein shame, guilt aur body image

body.en: Many adults carry shame learned in childhood: about desire, masturbation, past relationships, sexual orientation, or a body that does not match film standards, whether that is penis or breast size, skin colour, weight, stretch marks or scars. Shame keeps people away from doctors, honest conversations and contraception, so it costs health as well as happiness. Two useful questions are: who taught me this was shameful, and is it actually true? Guilt about really hurting someone deserves action: apologise and change. Shame about being an ordinary human deserves accurate information and kinder company. If thoughts about your body or eating are taking over your day, that is a good reason to speak to a professional.
body.hg: Bahut se adults bachpan mein seekhi hui shame dhote hain: desire ko lekar, masturbation, past relationships, sexual orientation ko lekar, ya aisi body ko lekar jo film standards par fit nahi baithti, chahe woh penis ya breast size ho, skin colour, weight, stretch marks ya scars. Shame logon ko doctor, honest conversations aur contraception se door rakhti hai, isliye iski keemat khushi ke saath health bhi chukati hai. Do useful sawaal hain: mujhe kisne sikhaya ki yeh sharam ki baat hai, aur kya yeh actually sach hai? Kisi ko sach mein hurt karne ka guilt ho, toh action lo: sorry bolo aur badlo. Ek ordinary insaan hone ki shame ho, toh usse sahi information aur kinder company chahiye. Agar body ya khaane ko lekar thoughts poora din ghere rehte hain, toh yeh kisi professional se baat karne ki achhi wajah hai.

h.hg: Professional help kaise kaam karti hai

body.en: A counsellor or clinical psychologist helps through talking therapy: understanding patterns and building skills. A psychiatrist is a medical doctor who can also assess whether medicines are needed; only a doctor should prescribe them. You do not need to be in crisis to go. Good reasons include low mood or anxiety lasting more than two weeks, panic, sleep problems, grief, a breakup, abuse, or simply feeling stuck. A first session is mostly questions about what is happening and what you want. Tele-MANAS on 14416 is free, runs round the clock and offers support in many Indian languages; government hospitals also have psychiatry departments. For thoughts of suicide or immediate danger, call 112 or 14416 and stay with someone you trust.
body.hg: Counsellor ya clinical psychologist talking therapy se help karte hain: apne patterns samajhna aur nayi skills banana. Psychiatrist ek medical doctor hote hain jo yeh bhi assess kar sakte hain ki medicines ki zaroorat hai ya nahi; dawa sirf doctor ko hi prescribe karni chahiye. Jaane ke liye crisis mein hona zaroori nahi hai. Achhi wajahein hain: do hafte se zyada chalne wala low mood ya anxiety, panic, neend ki problem, grief, breakup, abuse, ya bas yeh feel hona ki tum stuck ho. Pehle session mein zyadatar yahi poochha jaata hai ki kya chal raha hai aur tum kya chahte ho. Tele-MANAS 14416 free hai, 24 ghante chalta hai aur kai Indian languages mein support deta hai; government hospitals mein psychiatry departments bhi hote hain. Suicide ke thoughts aayein ya turant khatra ho, toh 112 ya 14416 par call karo aur kisi bharose wale insaan ke saath raho.

claim.en: Therapy is only for people who are 'pagal' or weak.
claim.hg: Therapy sirf 'pagal' ya weak logon ke liye hoti hai.

fact.en: People see mental health professionals for stress, grief, relationships, sleep and decisions, not only for severe illness. Getting help early is practical self-care, like seeing a doctor for a fever that will not go.
fact.hg: Log mental health professionals ke paas stress, grief, relationships, neend aur decisions ke liye jaate hain, sirf severe illness ke liye nahi. Jaldi help lena practical self-care hai, jaise na utarne wale bukhaar ke liye doctor ke paas jaana.

takeaways.en: Sleep, food, movement and one honest conversation a week are real protection against chronic stress.
takeaways.hg: Neend, khana, movement aur hafte mein ek honest conversation chronic stress se real protection hain.

takeaways.en: Being sexually active, waiting or never wanting sex are all valid adult choices, and nobody owes anyone sex.
takeaways.hg: Sexually active hona, wait karna ya sex kabhi na chahna, sab valid adult choices hain, aur sex kisi ka kisi par udhaar nahi hai.

takeaways.en: You can see a counsellor, psychologist or psychiatrist before things become a crisis, and 14416 is free.
takeaways.hg: Crisis banne se pehle bhi counsellor, psychologist ya psychiatrist se mil sakte ho, aur 14416 free hai.

activity.en: Do a five-minute stress audit: write the three biggest pressures on you right now, mark which are your own goals and which are someone else's timeline, and note one small step for the heaviest one.
activity.hg: Paanch minute ka stress audit karo: is waqt ke apne teen sabse bade pressures likho, mark karo ki kaun-se tumhare apne goals hain aur kaun-si kisi aur ki timeline hai, aur sabse heavy wale ke liye ek chhota step likho.

q.en: After you say no to sex, a partner keeps sulking and insulting you until you give in. What is this?
q.hg: Tumhare sex se mana karne ke baad partner tab tak roothta aur insult karta rehta hai jab tak tum maan na jao. Yeh kya hai?

options.en: Proof of strong attraction
options.hg: Strong attraction ka proof

options.en: A normal reaction that you should fix by agreeing
options.hg: Ek normal reaction jisse tumhe maankar theek kar dena chahiye

options.en: Coercion
options.hg: Coercion, yaani zabardasti

explain.en: Wearing someone down with sulking, insults or threats is coercion. A yes given to end the pressure is not free consent.
explain.hg: Roothkar, insult karke ya dhamkakar kisi ko thaka dena coercion hai. Pressure khatam karne ke liye boli gayi 'haan' free consent nahi hai.

q.en: You should see a counsellor or psychologist only when you are in a severe crisis.
q.hg: Counsellor ya psychologist ke paas tabhi jaana chahiye jab tum severe crisis mein ho.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Support works best early. Stress, grief, sleep trouble or feeling stuck are all good enough reasons to go.
explain.hg: Support jaldi lene par best kaam karta hai. Stress, grief, neend ki problem ya stuck feel karna, yeh sab jaane ki kaafi achhi wajahein hain.

warning.en: If you are having thoughts of suicide or self-harm, please reach out now: call Tele-MANAS on 14416 or 112, and stay with someone you trust until help arrives.
warning.hg: Agar suicide ya self-harm ke thoughts aa rahe hain, toh please abhi reach out karo: Tele-MANAS 14416 ya 112 par call karo, aur help milne tak kisi bharose wale insaan ke saath raho.

title.en: What Silence Costs: Bodies, Minds and Asking for Help
title.hg: Chuppi ki Keemat: Body, Mind aur Help Maangna

subtitle.en: Eating disorders, body dysmorphia, men's mental health, depression after childbirth, shame after abuse and suicide warning signs
subtitle.hg: Eating disorders, body dysmorphia, men ki mental health, delivery ke baad depression, abuse ke baad shame aur suicide ke warning signs

hook.en: 'I'm fine' is the most common lie in mental health. This lesson is about what it can hide, in every gender, and what to do when you suspect it.
hook.hg: 'Main theek hoon' mental health ka sabse common jhooth hai. Yeh lesson is baare mein hai ki iske peeche kya-kya chhupa ho sakta hai, har gender mein, aur jab tumhe shak ho toh kya karna hai.

objectives.en: Recognise signs of eating disorders and body dysmorphia, including muscle dysmorphia, in people of any gender.
objectives.hg: Kisi bhi gender ke logon mein eating disorders aur body dysmorphia, jisme muscle dysmorphia bhi shaamil hai, ke signs pehchaan sako.

objectives.en: Explain why men seek help less, how depression can follow childbirth in mothers and fathers, and why shame after abuse belongs to the abuser.
objectives.hg: Samjha sako ki men help kam kyun maangte hain, delivery ke baad mothers aur fathers dono ko depression kaise ho sakta hai, aur abuse ke baad ki shame asal mein abuser ki kyun hai.

objectives.en: Name suicide warning signs and the three steps for responding: ask directly, stay, connect to help.
objectives.hg: Suicide ke warning signs aur respond karne ke teen steps bata sako: seedha poocho, saath raho, help se connect karo.

h.en: When food, the mirror or muscle takes over
h.hg: Jab khana, mirror ya muscles dimaag pe haavi ho jaayein

body.en: Eating disorders are serious illnesses, not diets or vanity. Anorexia means severe restriction and intense fear of weight gain. Bulimia and binge eating disorder involve binges, eating large amounts while feeling out of control, often in secret; bulimia adds getting rid of the food or over-exercising. They affect every gender and body size; looks do not tell. Body dysmorphic disorder means hours lost worrying about a 'flaw' others barely notice. In muscle dysmorphia, more common in men, a person feels small however muscular they are, and may turn to extreme training, diets or anabolic steroids, which can harm the heart, mood and fertility. All are treatable. Start with a doctor.
body.hg: Eating disorders serious illnesses hain, dieting ya show-off nahi. Anorexia mein insaan khana bahut zyada kam kar deta hai aur use weight badhne ka gehra darr rehta hai. Bulimia aur binge eating disorder mein binges hote hain, yaani out of control hokar bahut zyada kha lena, aksar chhupke; bulimia mein iske baad insaan khane ko body se nikalne ki koshish karta hai ya hadd se zyada exercise karta hai. Yeh har gender aur har body size ke logon ko hote hain; dekhkar pata nahi chalta. Body dysmorphic disorder ek alag trap hai: kisi aisi 'kami' ki chinta mein ghanton nikal jaana jo doosron ko mushkil se dikhti hai. Muscle dysmorphia mein, jo men mein zyada dekha jata hai, insaan kitna bhi muscular ho, khud ko chhota hi feel karta hai, aur extreme training, rigid diet ya anabolic steroids ki taraf ja sakta hai, jo heart, mood aur fertility ko harm kar sakte hain. In sabka treatment possible hai. Shuruaat doctor se karo.

h.en: Depression in disguise: men, new mothers, new fathers
h.hg: Bhes badle depression: men, nayi mothers, naye fathers

body.en: Boys hear 'mard ko dard nahi hota' so early that many men cannot put sadness into words. Their depression often shows as irritability, anger, drinking, overwork or silence, and they visit doctors less. The cost is brutal: in India, as in most countries, more men than women die by suicide. Depression can follow childbirth. Low mood, anxiety, guilt or feeling nothing for the baby lasting beyond two weeks may be postnatal depression, not bad mothering. Fathers get it too, especially with money stress and no sleep. It is common and treatable. Thoughts of harming yourself or the baby, or seeing or hearing things that are not there, need emergency care.
body.hg: Ladke 'mard ko dard nahi hota' itni jaldi sun lete hain ki bahut se men apni udaasi ko words hi nahi de paate. Unka depression aksar chidchidepan, gusse, drinking, overwork ya chuppi ke roop mein dikhta hai, aur woh doctor ke paas kam jaate hain. Iski keemat brutal hai: India mein, zyadatar countries ki tarah, suicide se women ke comparison mein zyada men ki maut hoti hai. Depression bacche ke janm ke baad bhi aata hai. Do hafte se zyada chalne wala low mood, anxiety, guilt ya bacche ke liye kuch feel na hona postnatal depression ho sakta hai, yeh buri maa hona nahi hai. Fathers ko bhi yeh ho sakta hai, khaaskar paise ki tension aur neend ki kami ke saath. Yeh common hai aur treatable hai. Khud ko ya bacche ko harm karne ke thoughts aayein, ya aisi cheezein dikhein ya sunai dein jo hain hi nahi, toh turant emergency care chahiye.

body.en: After sexual, physical or emotional abuse, many survivors of every gender feel dirty, guilty or to blame: 'I did not shout', 'I went there myself', 'my body reacted'. None of that makes it your fault. Freezing is an automatic survival response, and a physical reaction is a reflex, not consent. Shame keeps people silent for years, and that silence protects only the abuser. Nightmares, numbness, anger, flashbacks and trouble trusting are common trauma reactions, not weakness, and they ease with support. You choose whom to tell and when. For under-18s, doctors and counsellors must report sexual abuse, so they cannot promise complete secrecy, but they can help keep you safe.
body.hg: Sexual, physical ya emotional abuse ke baad har gender ke bahut se survivors khud ko ganda, guilty ya zimmedaar feel karte hain: 'main chillayi nahi', 'main khud wahan gaya tha', 'meri body ne react kiya'. Inme se kisi baat se yeh tumhari galti nahi ban jaati. Freeze ho jaana ek automatic survival response hai, aur physical reaction ek reflex hai, consent nahi. Shame logon ko saalon chup rakhti hai, aur yeh chuppi sirf usi ko protect karti hai jisne harm kiya. Nightmares, numbness, gussa, flashbacks aur logon pe trust na kar paana trauma ke common reactions hain, weakness nahi, aur support milne pe yeh halke padte hain. Kise batana hai aur kab, yeh tum decide karte ho. Agar tum 18 se kam ho, toh doctors aur counsellors ko sexual abuse report karna hota hai, isliye woh complete secrecy ka promise nahi kar sakte, par woh tumhe safe rakhne mein help kar sakte hain.

h.en: Suicide warning signs and how to respond
h.hg: Suicide ke warning signs aur respond kaise karein

body.en: Take these signs seriously: talking about wanting to die, being a burden or having no way out; saying goodbye or giving away valued things; withdrawing from everyone; sudden calm after a long low; heavier drinking or drug use. Then do three things. Ask directly: 'Are you thinking about suicide?' Asking does not plant the idea. Listen without arguing, lecturing or promising secrecy. Stay with them; never leave a person in crisis alone. Connect them to help: Tele-MANAS on 14416 at any hour, a doctor or a trusted adult, and 112 if danger is immediate. Check in again the next day. You need not fix their life, only stay and connect.
body.hg: In signs ko seriously lo: marne ki ichha, burden hone ya koi raasta na bachne ki baatein karna; goodbye bolna ya apni pyaari cheezein baant dena; sabse cut-off ho jaana; lambe low ke baad achanak calm ho jaana; drinking ya drugs ka badh jaana. Phir teen kaam karo. Seedha poocho: 'Kya tum suicide ke baare mein soch rahe ho?' Poochne se yeh idea dimaag mein nahi baithta. Argue kiye bina, lecture diye bina aur secret rakhne ka promise kiye bina suno. Unke saath raho; crisis mein phanse insaan ko akela nahi chhodna chahiye. Unhe help se connect karo: Tele-MANAS 14416, jo har time open hai, koi doctor ya trusted adult, aur danger turant ka ho toh 112. Agle din phir haal poocho. Tumhe unki life fix nahi karni, bas saath rehna hai aur connect karna hai.

claim.en: People who talk about suicide are only seeking attention and will not actually do it.
claim.hg: Jo log suicide ki baat karte hain woh sirf attention chahte hain aur actually karenge nahi.

fact.en: Many people who die by suicide had talked about it or shown signs beforehand. Talk of dying is a call for help and should always be taken seriously: ask directly, stay with the person and connect them to Tele-MANAS 14416, or 112 in an emergency.
fact.hg: Suicide se marne wale bahut se logon ne pehle iski baat ki thi ya signs diye the. Marne ki baat help ki pukaar hai aur isse hamesha seriously lena chahiye: seedha poocho, us insaan ke saath raho aur use Tele-MANAS 14416 se, ya emergency mein 112 se connect karo.

takeaways.en: Eating disorders and body dysmorphia affect all genders and body sizes, and they are illnesses that respond to treatment.
takeaways.hg: Eating disorders aur body dysmorphia har gender aur har body size ke logon ko ho sakte hain, aur yeh aisi illnesses hain jo treatment se theek hoti hain.

takeaways.en: Depression in men and in new mothers and fathers, and shame after abuse, are common, hidden and treatable; none of them is weakness or guilt.
takeaways.hg: Men mein aur nayi mothers aur naye fathers mein depression, aur abuse ke baad ki shame, common hain, chhupi rehti hain aur treatable hain; inme se kuch bhi weakness ya kasoor nahi hai.

takeaways.en: If you see suicide warning signs, ask directly, stay with the person and connect them to Tele-MANAS 14416 or 112.
takeaways.hg: Agar suicide ke warning signs dikhein, toh seedha poocho, us insaan ke saath raho aur use Tele-MANAS 14416 ya 112 se connect karo.

activity.en: Prepare your three sentences. Privately write the exact words you would use to ask a friend directly whether they are thinking about suicide, to tell them you are staying, and to suggest calling 14416 together. Then save 14416 and 112 in your phone.
activity.hg: Apne teen sentences ready rakho. Privately exactly woh words likho jinse tum kisi dost se seedha poochoge ki kya woh suicide ke baare mein soch raha hai, use bataoge ki tum uske saath ruk rahe ho, aur saath milke 14416 pe call karne ka suggestion doge. Phir 14416 aur 112 apne phone mein save kar lo.

q.en: Your friend Kabir has been withdrawn for weeks. Tonight he messages, 'Everyone will be better off without me', and gives you his favourite headphones to keep. What should you do?
q.hg: Tumhara dost Kabir kai hafton se sabse cut-off hai. Aaj raat woh message karta hai, 'Mere bina sab better rahenge', aur apne favourite headphones tumhe rakhne ke liye de deta hai. Tumhe kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Send a joke to lighten his mood and check on him next week
options.hg: Uska mood halka karne ke liye koi joke bhejna aur agle hafte haal poochna

options.en: Keep it to yourself, because he trusted you with it
options.hg: Yeh baat apne tak rakhna, kyunki usne tum pe trust kiya hai

options.en: Ask him directly if he is thinking about suicide, make sure he is not alone, and connect him to 14416 or 112
options.hg: Usse seedha poochna ki kya woh suicide ke baare mein soch raha hai, pakka karna ki woh akela na rahe, aur use 14416 ya 112 se connect karna

options.en: Tell him other people have bigger problems, so he gets some perspective
options.hg: Use batana ki doosron ki problems isse badi hain, taaki use perspective mile

explain.en: Talking about being a burden and giving away valued things are warning signs. Asking directly, staying with the person and connecting them to help is the response that protects; jokes, secrecy and comparisons leave them alone with it.
explain.hg: Burden hone ki baatein karna aur apni pyaari cheezein de dena warning signs hain. Seedha poochna, saath rehna aur help se connect karna hi woh response hai jo protect karta hai; jokes, secrecy aur comparison use iske saath akela chhod dete hain.

q.en: Depression after a baby is born can affect fathers as well as mothers.
q.hg: Bacche ke janm ke baad ka depression mothers ke saath-saath fathers ko bhi ho sakta hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Postnatal depression is best known in mothers, but new fathers can develop it too, often showing as irritability or withdrawal. It is treatable in both parents.
explain.hg: Postnatal depression mothers mein zyada jaana jata hai, par naye fathers ko bhi ho sakta hai, aur aksar chidchidepan ya withdrawal ke roop mein dikhta hai. Dono parents mein yeh treatable hai.

warning.en: If you or someone else may act on thoughts of suicide, call 112 now and do not leave the person alone. Tele-MANAS on 14416 is free and open at all hours. Fainting, chest pain or a racing heart alongside an eating problem, or thoughts of harming a baby, also need urgent medical care. If abuse is still happening or you are not safe, call 112. Under 18, you can also call Child Helpline 1098 for abuse or any crisis, and women and girls can call Women Helpline 181.
warning.hg: Agar tum ya koi aur suicide ke thoughts pe act kar sakta hai, toh abhi 112 pe call karo aur us insaan ko akela mat chhodo. Tele-MANAS 14416 free hai aur har time open hai. Eating problem ke saath behoshi, chest pain ya dil ki tez dhadkan ho, ya bacche ko harm karne ke thoughts aayein, toh bhi turant medical care chahiye. Agar abuse abhi bhi ho raha hai ya tum safe nahi ho, toh 112 pe call karo. 18 se kam ho toh abuse ya kisi bhi crisis mein Child Helpline 1098 pe bhi call kar sakte ho, aur women aur ladkiyan Women Helpline 181 pe call kar sakti hain.
